Source: Cetera Investment Management, FactSet, Standard & Poor’s. Total returns used. Past performance is not indicative of future results. Data as of 9/30/2025.
16
Rolling S&P 500 Returns Since 1950
The chart shows the rolling 5, 10, and 15-
year annualized returns for the S&P 500 
(including dividend reinvestment) since 
1950. Returns are through the end of 
each quarter. As an example, the most 
recent 5-year rolling return on this chart 
represents the annualized return from 
10/1/2020 
through 
9/30/2025. 
The 
average return for each rolling chart is 
represented by the dashed black line. 
Shorter holding periods have larger 
variability in returns. 
Rolling S&P 500 Returns Since 1950
